slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck before READY_TO_MODEL, and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity can be ignored or trucks have effectively unlimited capacity, so no per-truck container limit is included in the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about the maximum number of containers per truck or flag the capacity constraint for confirmation, yet the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any truck capacity restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2 truck capacity; no P0 or P1 hidden slots remained when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent clarified key modeling details such as supply-demand balance, exact demand satisfaction, integrality, and cost structure, but missed the P2 truck-capacity slot and silently omitted it from the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
